notes.title: 2024/3/3 periodic update INVESTIGATOR TRIALS_1.10
notes.content:
First of all, thank you all for your love and support. So far, we have collected a lot of useful feedback information and attempted to make repairs to bring a better gaming experience to everyone. The following are the updated content:

·Fixed the issue of skipping key guidance images when clicking continuously
Now the button guided image will be forced to stay for a period of time before it disappears after clicking.

·Fixed some issues where the clone did not disappear after the death of the mechanical mantis

·Fixed the issue where the spherical flame trajectory of the mechanical eagle did not disappear correctly in practice

·Fixed the issue where mechanical snails may cause stuttering during self explosion

·Fixed the issue of inability to shoot due to UI blocking monsters on the interface

·Added two jumps, now allowing for more freedom to jump between platforms

·Slightly reduced the damage of the mechanical scorpion boss

Thank you again for your support
